viruses.blurb: Viruses are microscopic infectious agents that can only replicate inside living cells. From the common cold to COVID-19, viral diseases range from mild to serious and potentially fatal. Browse our reviewed by experts guides on symptoms, transmission, and treatment.

bacteria.blurb: Bacteria are single-celled organisms that can cause a wide range of infections in the human body. Unlike viruses, most bacterial infections can be treated with antibiotics. Learn about symptoms, causes, prevention, and the right treatment approaches.
